title: Cirque Alice brings a one-of-a-kind theatrical experience to Manila
summary: A one-of-a-kind theatrical experience awaits Manila audiences as “Cirque Alice” brings Lewis Carroll’s beloved Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland to life on stage from Oct. 16 to 25, 2026.
